title: Verdict
description: CATO's terminal judgment on a candidate. Only CATO emits this, in a separate isolation boundary from the producer.

verdict.description: The only admissible outcomes. 'confirmed' requires reproduced_from_bytes = true.

verifier_identity.description: The distinct execution identity that verified. Must differ from the candidate's producer (generator != verifier).

reproduced_from_bytes.description: True only if the PoC artifact re-executed to the expected effect in a clean environment.

environment_digest.description: Digest of the clean environment CATO used.

reasons.description: Why this verdict. For not_reproduced, what failed.
